body.name: Moore--Penrose comparator and full-normal diagnostic
body.construction: For each training complement of \(I_\ell\), form \(\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}\). For the OVS comparator, solve each block KKT system \(\begin{psmallmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}_{kk}&\mathbf 1\\\mathbf 1'&0\end{psmallmatrix}\binom{v_k}{\lambda_k}=\binom{0}{\omega_k}\) by its Moore--Penrose inverse; for the joint constant comparator, solve \(\begin{psmallmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}&A\\A'&0\end{psmallmatrix}\binom{v}{\lambda}=\binom{0}{\omega}\) in the same way. Take the minimum-Euclidean-norm loading component \(\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}\). Report \(\widehat d^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)=N'\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}\) for equality with the aggregate optimum and \(\widehat e^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)=\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat Z^{\mathrm{per},-\ell}\{\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}\prime}\widehat\Psi^{-\ell}\}\mid X=x]\) for equality with the full canonical gradient.
